spans.s:
m. (-डः)
The post to which an elephant is bound.

f. (-णिः or -णी)
The earth.
E.
क्ष to sound, अणि affix, fem. affix optionally ङीप्; also क्षौणि.

m. (-दः)
1 Powder, pulverized substance.
2 A piece, a small piece or particle.
3 The stone or slab on which any thing is [] ground or powdered, a mortar, &c.
3 Dust.
E.
क्षुद to bruise^1 or pound, affix घञ्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Ground, pulverized.
E.
क्षोद, and रज for रजस् dust.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pounded, ground, comminuted.
n. (-तं)
Powder, dust, substance pulverized or ground.
E.
क्षुद to bruise or pound, affix क्त.

m. (-मा)
Minuteness, exceeding smallness or inferiority.
E.
क्षुद्र small, &c. Affix इमनिच्, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Finely pounded or levigated, very small or minute.
E.
क्षुद्र small, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative, र rejected.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very fine or small.
E.
क्षुद्र, and इयसुन् affix of the superlative.

m. (-भः)
1 Agitation, emotion.
2 Shaking, trembling, tossing.
E.
क्षुभ to be agitated, घञ् aff.

mn. (-मः-मं)
A room on the top of a house: see क्षौम
n. (-मं)
Wove silk.
E.
क्षु to make a sound, Uṇādi affix मन्; also क्षौम.
